angle_en: Avashah api: even against his will
angle_hi: अवशोऽपि: अपनी इच्छा के विरुद्ध भी

en.intro: Carrying on, Krishna tells Arjuna that the pull of past practice is so strong that a person is drawn back even when they are not in control. Listen for the word that marks this involuntary pull.
en.notice: The word avashah api means even against his will. Krishna says that past practice is so strong that it pulls a person forward even when they are not in control.
en.next: Krishna then explains that this very practice also carries a seeker past the mere sound of ritual words.
en.meaning: Even against his will, he is drawn onward by that earlier practice. Even the seeker of yoga goes beyond the sound of ritual words.

hi.intro: आगे श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि पूर्व जन्म के अभ्यास का खिंचाव इतना गहरा होता है कि मनुष्य अपनी इच्छा के बिना भी खिंच जाता है। ध्यान से सुनिए।
hi.meaning: श्रीमानों के घर जन्मा हुआ योगभ्रष्ट मनुष्य भोगों के वश में रहते हुए भी पिछले जन्म के अभ्यास के कारण परमात्मा की ओर खिंच जाता है। योग का केवल जिज्ञासु भी वेदों में कहे सकाम कर्मों के फल से आगे निकल जाता है।
hi.notice: अवशोऽपि सः, यानी अपनी इच्छा के विरुद्ध भी। श्रीकृष्ण कहते हैं कि पूर्व जन्म का अभ्यास इतना मजबूत होता है कि वह मनुष्य को उसकी मर्जी के बिना भी अपनी ओर खींच लेता है।
hi.next: यह अभ्यास ही उस जिज्ञासु को भी वेदों में कहे सकाम कर्मों के फल से ऊपर उठा देता है।

en.intro: Carrying on, Krishna tells Arjuna that the pull of past practice is so strong that a person is drawn back even when they are not in control. Listen for the word that marks this involuntary pull.
en.body: Even against his will, he is drawn onward by that earlier practice. Even the seeker of yoga goes beyond the sound of ritual words. The word avashah api means even against his will.
